+import json
+import os
+import re
+from typing import Dict
+
+import requests
+
+
+OPENAI_API_URL = "https://api.openai.com/v1/responses"
+OPENAI_MODEL = "gpt-5.4-mini"
+
+
+def _extract_json_object(text: str) -> Dict[str, str]:
+    text = text.strip()
+    try:
+        data = json.loads(text)
+        return data if isinstance(data, dict) else {}
+    except json.JSONDecodeError:
+        match = re.search(r"\{.*\}", text, re.DOTALL)
+        if not match:
+            return {}
+        try:
+            data = json.loads(match.group(0))
+            return data if isinstance(data, dict) else {}
+        except json.JSONDecodeError:
+            return {}
+
+
+def extract_key_values(document: str) -> Dict[str, str]:
+    api_key = os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY")
+    if not api_key:
+        raise RuntimeError("OPENAI_API_KEY is required")
+
+    prompt = (
+        "Extract all key-value pairs from the form-like document. "
+        "Return only a JSON object mapping keys to string values. "
+        "If a value appears multiple times, keep the most complete one.\n\n"
+        f"Document:\n{document}"
+    )
+    payload = {
+        "model": OPENAI_MODEL,
+        "input": prompt,
+        "temperature": 0,
+    }
+    response = requests.post(
+        OPENAI_API_URL,
+        headers={
+            "Authorization": f"Bearer {api_key}",
+            "Content-Type": "application/json",
+        },
+        json=payload,
+        timeout=60,
+    )
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    data = response.json()
+
+    text = ""
+    if isinstance(data, dict):
+        if "output_text" in data and isinstance(data["output_text"], str):
+            text = data["output_text"]
+        else:
+            outputs = data.get("output", [])
+            parts = []
+            for item in outputs:
+                for content in item.get("content", []):
+                    if content.get("type") in {"output_text", "text"}:
+                        parts.append(content.get("text", ""))
+            text = "\n".join(parts)
+
+    parsed = _extract_json_object(text)
+    return {str(k): str(v) for k, v in parsed.items()}
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    import sys
+
+    doc = sys.stdin.read()
+    print(json.dumps(extract_key_values(doc), ensure_ascii=False))
*** End Patch

+import json
+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional
+
+from google.cloud import documentai
+
+
+def _env(name: str, required: bool = True) -> Optional[str]:
+    value = os.getenv(name)
+    if required and not value:
+        raise ValueError(f"Missing required environment variable: {name}")
+    return value
+
+
+def extract_tables(document_path: str, project_id: Optional[str] = None, location: Optional[str] = None, processor_id: Optional[str] = None, mime_type: str = "application/pdf") -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    project_id = project_id or _env("GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT")
+    location = location or _env("GOOGLE_CLOUD_LOCATION") or "us"
+    processor_id = processor_id or _env("DOCUMENT_AI_PROCESSOR_ID")
+
+    client = documentai.DocumentProcessorServiceClient()
+    name = client.processor_path(project_id, location, processor_id)
+
+    with open(document_path, "rb") as f:
+        raw_document = documentai.RawDocument(content=f.read(), mime_type=mime_type)
+
+    request = documentai.ProcessRequest(name=name, raw_document=raw_document)
+    result = client.process_document(request=request)
+    document = result.document
+
+    extracted_tables: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for page_index, page in enumerate(document.pages):
+        for table_index, table in enumerate(page.tables):
+            rows: List[List[str]] = []
+            for row in table.header_rows + table.body_rows:
+                cells: List[str] = []
+                for cell in row.cells:
+                    text = _text_from_anchor(document.text, cell.layout.text_anchor)
+                    cells.append(text)
+                rows.append(cells)
+
+            extracted_tables.append(
+                {
+                    "page": page_index + 1,
+                    "table_index": table_index,
+                    "header_rows": len(table.header_rows),
+                    "body_rows": len(table.body_rows),
+                    "rows": rows,
+                }
+            )
+
+    return {"tables": extracted_tables}
+
+
+def _text_from_anchor(text: str, text_anchor: Any) -> str:
+    if not text_anchor or not getattr(text_anchor, "text_segments", None):
+        return ""
+    parts: List[str] = []
+    for segment in text_anchor.text_segments:
+        start = int(segment.start_index) if segment.start_index else 0
+        end = int(segment.end_index) if segment.end_index else len(text)
+        parts.append(text[start:end])
+    return "".join(parts).strip()
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    import argparse
+
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Extract tables from a document using Google Cloud Document AI")
+    parser.add_argument("document_path")
+    parser.add_argument("--project-id")
+    parser.add_argument("--location")
+    parser.add_argument("--processor-id")
+    parser.add_argument("--mime-type", default="application/pdf")
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+
+    print(
+        json.dumps(
+            extract_tables(
+                args.document_path,
+                project_id=args.project_id,
+                location=args.location,
+                processor_id=args.processor_id,
+                mime_type=args.mime_type,

+            ensure_ascii=False,
+            indent=2,
+        )
+    )
+
+

+    main()

+import argparse
+import json
+import os
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import requests
+
+
+MICROSOFT_AZURE_FORM_RECOGNIZER_ENDPOINT = os.environ.get("AZURE_DOCUMENT_INTELLIGENCE_ENDPOINT")
+MICROSOFT_AZURE_FORM_RECOGNIZER_KEY = os.environ.get("AZURE_DOCUMENT_INTELLIGENCE_KEY")
+MICROSOFT_AZURE_FORM_RECOGNIZER_API_VERSION = "2024-02-29-preview"
+
+
+def extract_layout(document_path: str):
+    if not MICROSOFT_AZURE_FORM_RECOGNIZER_ENDPOINT or not MICROSOFT_AZURE_FORM_RECOGNIZER_KEY:
+        raise RuntimeError("AZURE_DOCUMENT_INTELLIGENCE_ENDPOINT and AZURE_DOCUMENT_INTELLIGENCE_KEY are required")
+
+    path = Path(document_path)
+    if not path.is_file():
+        raise FileNotFoundError(document_path)
+
+    url = (
+        MICROSOFT_AZURE_FORM_RECOGNIZER_ENDPOINT.rstrip("/")
+        + "/documentintelligence/documentModels/prebuilt-layout:analyze?api-version="
+        + MICROSOFT_AZURE_FORM_RECOGNIZER_API_VERSION
+    )
+
+    headers = {
+        "Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key": MICROSOFT_AZURE_FORM_RECOGNIZER_KEY,
+        "Content-Type": "application/octet-stream",
+    }
+
+    with path.open("rb") as f:
+        response = requests.post(url, headers=headers, data=f.read(), timeout=120)
+    response.raise_for_status()
+
+    operation_location = response.headers.get("operation-location") or response.headers.get("Operation-Location")
+    if not operation_location:
+        return response.json()
+
+    poll_headers = {"Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key": MICROSOFT_AZURE_FORM_RECOGNIZER_KEY}
+    while True:
+        poll_response = requests.get(operation_location, headers=poll_headers, timeout=120)
+        poll_response.raise_for_status()
+        payload = poll_response.json()
+        status = payload.get("status")
+        if status in {"succeeded", "failed", "canceled"}:
+            return payload
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Extract layout elements from a document using Azure Document Intelligence.")
+    parser.add_argument("document", help="Path to the document to analyze")
+    parser.add_argument("--output", help="Optional path to write JSON output")
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+
+    result = extract_layout(args.document)
+    output = json.dumps(result, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)
+
+    if args.output:
+        Path(args.output).write_text(output, encoding="utf-8")
+    else:
+        print(output)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
*** End Patch

+import argparse
+import json
+import os
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import requests
+
+
+MICROSOFT_AZURE_FORM_RECOGNIZER_ENDPOINT = os.environ.get("AZURE_DOCUMENT_INTELLIGENCE_ENDPOINT")
+MICROSOFT_AZURE_FORM_RECOGNIZER_KEY = os.environ.get("AZURE_DOCUMENT_INTELLIGENCE_KEY")
+MICROSOFT_AZURE_FORM_RECOGNIZER_API_VERSION = "2024-02-29-preview"
+
+
+def extract_layout(document_path: str):
+    if not MICROSOFT_AZURE_FORM_RECOGNIZER_ENDPOINT or not MICROSOFT_AZURE_FORM_RECOGNIZER_KEY:
+        raise RuntimeError("AZURE_DOCUMENT_INTELLIGENCE_ENDPOINT and AZURE_DOCUMENT_INTELLIGENCE_KEY are required")
+
+    path = Path(document_path)
+    if not path.is_file():
+        raise FileNotFoundError(document_path)
+
+    url = (
+        MICROSOFT_AZURE_FORM_RECOGNIZER_ENDPOINT.rstrip("/")
+        + "/documentintelligence/documentModels/prebuilt-layout:analyze?api-version="
+        + MICROSOFT_AZURE_FORM_RECOGNIZER_API_VERSION
+    )
+
+    headers = {
+        "Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key": MICROSOFT_AZURE_FORM_RECOGNIZER_KEY,
+        "Content-Type": "application/octet-stream",
+    }
+
+    with path.open("rb") as f:
+        response = requests.post(url, headers=headers, data=f.read(), timeout=120)
+    response.raise_for_status()
+
+    operation_location = response.headers.get("operation-location") or response.headers.get("Operation-Location")
+    if not operation_location:
+        return response.json()
+
+    poll_headers = {"Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key": MICROSOFT_AZURE_FORM_RECOGNIZER_KEY}
+    while True:
+        poll_response = requests.get(operation_location, headers=poll_headers, timeout=120)
+        poll_response.raise_for_status()
+        payload = poll_response.json()
+        status = payload.get("status")
+        if status in {"succeeded", "failed", "canceled"}:
+            return payload
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Extract layout elements from a document using Azure Document Intelligence.")
+    parser.add_argument("document", help="Path to the document to analyze")
+    parser.add_argument("--output", help="Optional path to write JSON output")
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+
+    result = extract_layout(args.document)
+    output = json.dumps(result, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)
+
+    if args.output:
+        Path(args.output).write_text(output, encoding="utf-8")
+    else:
+        print(output)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+import os

+
